items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: He picked all my cars. I learned to him how to make all them cars.

ctx.x: And the fifth car, I forget, they called it B flat seven. The white boy? Fifth. He said, what was that boy name which used to wake with you, the white boy? He named George Bourne. He don't play no more. He got a good head on it. The boy taking a single house, him and his sister. He made five depositments out of single house. He pitched a radio, television, and everything. And he didn't want to work at nothing no more. He said, he's tired, he wanted to rest, you know? He had a smart head. I didn't get that…
